content: Glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists (GLP-1 RAs), such as liraglutide and semaglutide, have been linked to an increased risk of worsening diabetic retinopathy in certain clinical studies. It is important to closely monitor the progression of retinopathy in patients who are being treated with GLP-1 RAs, particularly in those who already have established diabetic retinopathy. Additionally, individuals experiencing rapid reductions in hemoglobin A1C levels while on these medications should also be carefully observed for potential retinopathy progression.
